description: Land Acquisition - Puloly, Walliputam & Thunnalai, Wadamarachchi, Wadamarachchi North D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses on the legal process of taking possession of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilake) issuing the order, this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land acquisition. The detailed land descriptions and acquisition process make this a clear Land Gazette.
